assumptions_challenged: There exists a characterized source‑cell MCB/WCB for SGL‑001
Orthogonal QC assays for intact EV identity (particle count, protein/lipid markers, nucleic acid, non‑vesicular particle controls) are developed and validated (LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy)
A stability‑indicating, mechanism‑relevant potency assay is developed and correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint
≥3 GMP‑like production runs with release, stability, and potency data demonstrating lot‑to‑lot reproducibility have been performed
Formulation/device compatibility has been demonstrated with intact‑EV recovery ex vivo and in short in vivo recovery studies with appropriate controls
Rodent intranasal biodistribution data and assays are sufficient to attribute in vivo signal to intact EVs and to predict cross‑species CNS exposure
falsification_conditions: Provide MCB/WCB master records and characterization data demonstrating source‑cell identity, absence of adventitious agents, and consistency criteria

Submit validation reports for the orthogonal QC panel (particle count, protein/lipid markers, nucleic acid, and non‑vesicular particle controls) showing fit‑for‑purpose performance (documented LLOQ, specificity vs non‑vesicular particles, precision, accuracy)
Provide validated intact‑EV assays (including orthogonal approaches) with documented assay performance and use of appropriate negative/positive controls to attribute signal to intact vesicles
Develop and document a stability‑indicating, mechanism‑relevant potency assay and show quantitative correlation between assay readout and an in vivo PD endpoint in an appropriately controlled study

Deliver manufacturing records for ≥3 GMP‑like production runs with release testing results, stability data, and potency demonstrating lot‑to‑lot reproducibility within pre‑specified acceptance criteria

Demonstrate formulation and delivery device compatibility via ex vivo recovery and a short in vivo recovery study that uses intact‑EV‑specific assays and non‑vesicular controls to confirm recovery/functional integrity

Provide rodent and at least one larger‑species biodistribution data set acquired using the validated intact‑EV assays and bridging controls that attribute in vivo signal specifically to intact EVs and show comparability across lots
strongest_objection: The single allowed evidence (MISEV2023) is consensus guidance that prescribes principles for EV characterization and reporting but is not program-specific data. It therefore cannot by itself demonstrate that SGL-001 meets the CMC/analytics gating criteria required to advance into cross‑species PK/PD testing (i.e., it does not substitute for validated MCB/WCB records, orthogonal assay validation, GMP‑like batch records, stability‑indicating potency correlation, or formulation/device compatibility data).
